note: Offline sample: Gaia DR3 sources with parallax > 80 mas (≈ 12.5 pc), parallax_over_error > 10.
query: SELECT TOP 1000 designation, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ref_epoch FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax > 80 AND parallax_over_error > 10 ORDER BY parallax DESC
